question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?

rendered: The water-based NMC532 cathode lost 578[1] ppm of residual moisture. It started at 625 ppm[2] (measured at 20[3] °C) and ended at 47 ppm[4] after drying at 110-120[5] °C. The NMP-processed cathode reached 87 ppm[6] after drying at 100[7] °C under vacuum. So the water-based cathode's final value was 40[8] ppm lower than the NMP-processed value. Dried under the same conditions, the water-based cathode still held 160 ppm[9] of moisture.
